findings.explanation: Repeated cross-sectional surveys do not constitute annual surveillance or causal evidence.
findings.recommendation: Compare descriptively at observed survey rounds; do not interpolate missing years or infer significance.

findings.explanation: Different indicators must not be pooled as equivalent estimates.
findings.recommendation: Keep indicator-specific series separate; review definitions before any harmonization.
